description: Вінницька міська рада: airport and aviation datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Вінницька міська рада. Coverage: Вінницька міська рада. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about airport and aviation; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Структура підприємства КП"Аеропорт-Вінниця"; 1.11 Баланс КП "Аеропорт Вінниця" за 9 місяців 2019 року; 1.11 Звіт про фінансові результати за 9 місяців 2019 рік КП "Аеропорт . Formats seen: XML, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Other (Open), Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
